## Maps and Tokens for Chapter 5

Session 5 continues directly down from Chapter 4's Core Room -- no new dungeon, no
teleport to a fort arena. Load all three maps before players join; reposition tokens
scene by scene on the overview/vault maps rather than reloading between scenes.

### Scene → Map → Tokens

| Scene | Map File | Tokens to Place | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scene 0: The Crystal Is Failing | `Maptool/maps/campaign/S5_The_Wrath_of_Mars/s5_mars_vault_overview.jpg` | All PCs, Tribune_Lucius | Narrate the descent; no combat tokens yet. |
| Scene 1: Sunken Armory / Choking Hall | Same map, zones 2-3 | All PCs, Tribune_Lucius, optional Shadow ×2 or Wraith ×1 | Only place the optional undead if the table has burned few resources so far -- read the table, not the script. |
| Scene 2: Convergence Hall (three-passage choice) | `s5_mars_vault.jpg`, zone 3 | All PCs, Zombie ×3 (center passage only) or Specter ×(party size − 1) (east passage only) | West passage is a trap + a journal, no combat tokens. Only place tokens for the passage the party actually picks. |
| Scene 3: Vercingetorix's Last Stand | Same map, at the passage into the Sanctum | All PCs, Vercingetorix_Bound ×1 | Command the Fallen (used once, below half HP) can add Zombie ×1d4 from the same pool. |
| Scene 4: Antechamber of Mars | `s5_mars_confrontation.jpg` | All PCs, Mars ×1, optional Wight ×1 (Session 1 callback, branch-dependent), optional Wraith ×2 (rounds 1-2 presence-only summons) | Mars starts presence-only (rounds 1-2); place his token only once he fully manifests (round 3+) if the party pushes to combat. |

### NPC Tokens

| Token | File | Scene | Frame Colour |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tribune Lucius | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/named/Tribune_Lucius.rptok` | Scenes 0-4 -- the only fort NPC who travels with the party | Grey (divided loyalty; may become the Destroy ending's guardian) |
| Vercingetorix Bound | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/named/Vercingetorix_Bound.rptok` | Scene 3 only | Deep red (his true and final form -- do not reuse the older living-appearing Vercingetorix_the_Red token here) |
| Mars | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/creatures/Mars.rptok` | Scene 4, round 3+ (full manifestation) | Divine (do not place until he commits to combat) |

Legate Corvinus, Centurion Varro, and Augur Cassia do **not** appear until the epilogue,
back at the fort -- no MapTool scene is needed for that portion. Do not place their
tokens in the dungeon.

::: {.dm-note}
Do not place **Fausta_Luperci** or any **Thusnelda** token this session. Both belonged
to the retired fort-arena premise and have no role in the current chapter5.qmd. Their
token files remain on disk, unreferenced.
:::

### Creature Tokens

| Creature | File | Scene | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shadow | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/creatures/Shadow.rptok` | Scene 1 (optional) | ×2 | Reused from earlier sessions |
| Wraith | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/creatures/Wraith.rptok` | Scene 1 (optional) or Scene 4 rounds 1-2 | ×1-2 | Mars's Summon Fallen legendary action can add more, max 3 total across the fight |
| Zombie | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/creatures/Zombie.rptok` | Scene 2 (center passage) or Scene 3 (Command the Fallen) | ×3 (+1d4) | |
| Specter | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/creatures/Specter.rptok` | Scene 2 (east passage only) | × (party size − 1) | Hardest of the three passages |
| Wight | `Maptool/tokens/npcs/creatures/Wight.rptok` | Scene 4, branch-dependent | ×1 | Only place if the Session 1 Altar Chamber Wight was spared -- see chapter5.qmd's Scene 4 branch note |

All five creature tokens already exist from earlier sessions -- no new pipeline work
was needed for Chapter 5's roster beyond Vercingetorix Bound and Mars (both named NPCs,
see above).

### Map Files Location

All three maps are this project's own custom SVG battle maps, already built and scouted
for this session (Story 9.1):

```
Maptool/maps/s5_mars_vault_overview.html / .jpg
Maptool/maps/s5_mars_vault.html / .jpg
Maptool/maps/s5_mars_confrontation.html / .jpg
```

Run `bash Maptool/maps/build_campaign_maps.sh` to copy them, along with all tokens
above, into `Maptool/maps/campaign/S5_The_Wrath_of_Mars/` (idempotent).
